'''December 2000 Augusta tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Book Exchange, Augusta, GA on 30 December 2000. It is known from Paul Myers's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1583">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-31-augusta-ga-12-30-paul-md1583/ augusta-ga-12-30-paul-m], DeckTech (Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, 31 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-31-augusta-ga-12-30-paul-md1583/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Book Exchange, Augusta, GA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 8
